name: Bathyal-Col
description: An ocean of dust without banks. At the edge of sight, past a tidally locked hemisphere, mirage-cities rise and collapse by noon, and the light turns brutal and white.

The air carries cold salt and iodine, and sound behaves strangely: footsteps crack loud, then die without echo. At night the temperature drops fast enough to hear the rock tick as it contracts. Forests of black-leaved flora drink the dim light and exhale a scent like cold iron.
The oldest impact basin predates the system's estimated age by a comfortable margin. The survey bureau has quietly stopped publishing the numbers.
Whoever controls copper controls the approach lanes. Three factions have done the arithmetic, and only two of them are being subtle about it.
